name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 4 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.27 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
